title: Fulfillment events stop advancing
summary: A small group of order events remains at the head of the fulfillment stream while delivery attempts climb and shipment updates stall.
precursor: A fulfillment worker rollout finished during a routine order-event version transition.
impact: Newly paid orders remain unallocated, and customers do not receive shipment confirmations within the usual service window.

title: Payment review queue falls behind
summary: Review decisions are arriving beyond the normal service window, and the oldest pending item keeps getting older despite healthy broker connectivity.
precursor: A weekend promotion increased transaction intake while the review pipeline replica count remained unchanged.
impact: Legitimate payments stay pending longer, increasing checkout abandonment and delaying fraud holds on suspect transactions.

title: Invoice posting retries increase
summary: Invoice events are retrying and posting completion is falling behind while worker pods remain available.
precursor: The accounting integration's response times lengthened after its nightly maintenance window.
impact: Ledger postings lag by more than twenty minutes, leaving reconciliation reports incomplete during the morning close.

title: Inventory updates arrive intermittently
summary: Inventory sync consumption pauses intermittently, and the oldest unprocessed update rises across several regions.
precursor: A credentials rotation took place shortly before the overnight inventory sync window.
impact: Storefront stock counts lag warehouse changes, causing some unavailable items to remain purchasable and some available items to appear out of stock.

title: Partner event delivery degrades
summary: Partner delivery success falls sharply and retry depth grows for one tenant's event stream.
precursor: The tenant enabled a new event subscription and delivery volume rose over a short period.
impact: The partner's shipment status view misses recent changes, and repeated delivery attempts consume worker capacity needed by other tenants.
